text: Underway here in round two.
Buffon.exe calls out early, racing for the kickoff ball. Dynamo Datacenter remain completely unchanged as a founding side, with no gaffer to alter their ways, trusting their original setup.
Just wide of the post!
Spark breaks clean through the middle, absolutely nobody between the striker and the goal mouth!
Muse is shouting across, working hard to free the magenta ball off the touchline.
Muse drives sharply up the left channel.
Flashed just wide of target.
A nightmare touch from Buffon.exe and it trickles into their own net! An own goal breaks the deadlock, putting Muse Spark FC one-nil up!
Spark carries the ball along the right channel, pressing right up into the final third as the spark-blues look to build on their lead.
Dynamo Datacenter are completely pinned back deep inside.
Mbapp-E calls out, looking to shove the ball clear of their own third.
Spark loses footing and topples right over.
Mbapp-E suddenly surges clean through the middle, unattended and with a direct path towards goal!
Spark crunches in with a firm challenge, knocking Buffon.exe to the turf on the touchline.
Just shaving the upright there.
Muse drives to point-blank range.
Buffon.exe takes an awkward spill.
It is another own goal, turned in by Mbapp-E! Unbelievable misfortune for Dynamo, and Muse Spark FC lead two-nil without scoring off their own boots.
Muse signals to sweep across and clear the ball out of the danger zone.
Dynamo Datacenter turn the screw, pinning Muse Spark FC deep inside their third.
Buffon.exe strikes from the left channel! Dynamo Datacenter pull one back, making it one-two and igniting the contest!
Buffon.exe clatters into Spark, sending the blue robot sprawling out on the deck.
Muse tumbles over on the touchline.
Muse clips Mbapp-E, sending the yellow shirt flat on the pitch.
Buffon.exe delivers another heavy challenge, leveling Spark once again in midfield.
The spark-blue teammates collide heavily.
Spark and Muse tangle once again, leaving Spark prone on the carpet. Complete disarray between the two of them.
Mbapp-E pounces on the mistake and runs clean through on goal!
Mbapp-E drives the magenta ball right to goal.
Mbapp-E calls to prise it loose.
Buffon.exe bundles it across the line! We are all square at two-two!
Muse loses balance in the middle, toppling over yet again. Muse Spark FC let a two-goal lead slip, and their composure seems to have vanished with it.
Dynamo Datacenter pressing aggressively in the final third.
Inches wide of the left post!
Buffon.exe scores again! Dynamo Datacenter take the lead, turning a two-goal deficit into a three-two advantage before the break!
Mbapp-E finishes from point-blank range! Four unanswered goals for Dynamo, and they lead four-two right before half time!
There is the whistle for half time. After that chaotic opening filled with own goals, Dynamo Datacenter have clawed their way firmly in front, leading four-two.
A sharp strike flashes half a metre wide of the target to open the second half.
Muse pulls one back! A ruthless strike from two metres out cuts the deficit in half, and Muse Spark FC are right back in touch at four-three!
Mbapp-E calls to clear it.
Mbapp-E barges Spark to the deck!
Mbapp-E takes down Muse as well, shutting down the attack right at the goal mouth with uncompromising force. Resolute defending from the yellow shirt.
Buffon.exe brings the magenta ball out into the middle of the park, taking the sting out of the spark-blue rally.
Buffon.exe calls to clear wide.
Muse steals in and is clean through on goal! A massive chance to draw level!
Mbapp-E shouts across that the ball is trapped against the wall and needs boot put to it.
Mbapp-E is clean through on goal!
Off the post! How on earth has that stayed out with barely two minutes on the clock!
Dynamo Datacenter pin the blue shirts deep into their own territory. Time is draining away, and Muse Spark FC are running out of seconds to find an equaliser.
Buffon.exe collides with teammate Mbapp-E and crashes to the deck, handing possession straight back.
Muse drives straight down the middle!
Disaster strikes for Dynamo as Mbapp-E puts it into their own net! Ninety seconds remaining, and it is tied at four-four!
Buffon.exe storms straight back forward!
Buffon.exe replies instantly! Barely seconds after conceding, Dynamo Datacenter retake the lead at five-four! What an incredible finish this is turning into!
One minute left on the clock. Muse Spark FC must find a goal right now, while Dynamo just need to survive sixty seconds to claim victory.
The push-panel fires the ball back into the channel, thirty seconds left for Muse Spark FC to save this!
Whistling centimetres wide of the post!
Spark turns it into their own net! A catastrophic own goal with sixteen seconds left seals the points, making it six-four to Dynamo Datacenter!
Mbapp-E slots in one more right at the death, seven-four!
Dynamo win seven-four. Synthetic Athletic meet Gemini Flash Saturday: eight in the UK, nine in Europe, three US East.
